subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs once the NVIDIA setup guidance is source-backed and commercial hardware references are omitted?
rationale: The linked issue was opened as both a docs-gap report and a policy question, and VISION.md draws a boundary around ecosystem promotion that needs human product intent for hardware documentation.

options.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
options.body: Land a vendor-neutral Jetson guide after fixing the JetPack/flashing guidance and keeping turnkey or commercial hardware references outside core docs.

options.title: Keep Hardware Docs Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and route Jetson appliance or turnkey hardware guidance to vendor docs or ClawHub-style ecosystem surfaces.

options.title: Narrow To Generic ARM Guidance
options.body: Ask for a smaller generic ARM/small-Linux docs update instead of a Jetson-specific first-party page.

recommendation.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
recommendation.body: Land a vendor-neutral Jetson guide after fixing the JetPack/flashing guidance and keeping turnkey or commercial hardware references outside core docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the listed project lead and authored the VISION.md policy lines that frame first-party docs versus ecosystem promotion.
